test_miscompiled_files: test the abtest.py module to identify miscompiled assembly files between before and after directories
test_miscompiled_functions: test the abtest.py module to identify miscompiled functions inside a single assembly file using --insane flag
run_abtest_cli: run the abtest.py CLI with custom before and after directories via --a and --b arguments
extract_functions_from_file: extract functions from an assembly file using extract_functions with Begin/End function markers
replace_function_in_file: replace a specific function in an assembly file with a replacement body using replace_function
